A '''songfish''' was a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that was found in the [[Water/Legends|streams]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. It was capable of producing an audible piping noise.<ref name="Shadows" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]], [[Ves Volette]], experienced a [[memnis]] while on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During the experience, he heard songfish in a [[Unidentified Caamas stream|stream]] near his [[Ves Volette's hamlet|hamlet]] in [[Jualya Village]] before the village was [[Caamas Firestorm|destroyed]]. The memnis was a vivid memory caused by many offworld Caamasi learning of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] destruction of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
The songfish was first featured in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />
